mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25% over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 9.0%, it signals a weak labor market that may lead to central bank stimulus, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 9.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (both HOUST and RSAFS rising) fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 90, it signals supply constraints that lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to inflationary pressures and reduced corporate profits.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 90.

mechanism_narrative: When the core CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 217.0, it signals rising inflation that may lead to tighter monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in less than 45% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 217.0.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS is rising (over the past 6 months).

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions (as indicated by high GDP levels, e.g., GDPC1 > 13200), the S&P 500 tends to underperform due to valuation concerns and the likelihood of monetary tightening, leading to negative returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in less than 45% of periods when GDPC1 > 13200.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates a robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (both HOUST and GDPC1 rising) fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases.
